---
title: "Activos"
---

```{=html}

<div class="tf-page-header"><div><h1>Activos productivos</h1><div class="tf-muted">Compra, transporte, mantenimiento, certificación, depreciación, valor de mercado e ingresos.</div></div><button class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" data-logout>Cerrar sesión</button></div>
<div class="tf-grid tf-grid-2"><section class="tf-card"><h2>Registrar activo</h2><form id="asset-form" class="tf-form-grid"><div class="tf-field"><label>Nombre</label><input id="asset-name" required></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Tipo</label><select id="asset-type"><option value="equipment">Equipo</option><option value="vehicle">Vehículo</option><option value="other">Otro</option></select></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Precio compra ($)</label><input id="asset-purchase" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" required></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Transporte de compra ($)</label><input id="asset-purchase-transport" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="0"></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Accesorios iniciales ($)</label><input id="asset-accessories" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="0"></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Certificación inicial ($)</label><input id="asset-certification" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="0"></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Otros costos iniciales ($)</label><input id="asset-other-initial" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="0"></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Fecha compra</label><input id="asset-date" type="date"></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Valor residual ($)</label><input id="asset-residual" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="0"></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Vida útil (años)</label><input id="asset-life" type="number" min="0.1" step="0.1" value="5"></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Valor mercado actual ($)</label><input id="asset-market" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="0"></div><div class="tf-field" style="display:flex;align-items:end"><button class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary">Guardar activo</button></div></form></section>
<section class="tf-card"><h2>Registrar costo / ingreso</h2><form id="asset-event-form" class="tf-form-grid"><div class="tf-field tf-span-2"><label>Activo</label><select id="event-asset"></select></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Tipo</label><select id="event-kind"><option value="cost">Costo</option><option value="revenue">Ingreso</option></select></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Concepto</label><select id="event-concept"><option value="transport">Transporte</option><option value="maintenance">Mantenimiento</option><option value="certification">Certificación / calibración</option><option value="repair">Reparación</option><option value="insurance">Seguro</option><option value="rental">Arriendo / uso productivo</option><option value="other">Otro</option></select></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Fecha</label><input id="event-date" type="date"></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Monto ($)</label><input id="event-amount" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" required></div><div class="tf-field tf-span-2"><label>Detalle</label><input id="event-note"></div><div class="tf-span-2"><button class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary">Registrar evento</button></div></form></section></div><div id="asset-list" class="tf-grid tf-grid-3" style="margin-top:1rem"></div>


<script type="module" src="js/assets.js"></script>
```
